verdict.rationale: Codegen supports triggering agents via CI/CD, Slack, Linear, GitHub events, SDK, and API, and can run in isolated environments with logs/telemetry, which enables background/autonomous automation setups. However, there is no evidence of a native scheduler/cron-like trigger for fully unattended recurring runs, only event- or manually-triggered agent invocations. missing for 10: dedicated scheduling/cron trigger documentation, independent evidence of long-running unattended background jobs, third-party confirmation of reliability at scale.
